title: Lightning 1:1 brief — Ashwin Varma
content:
Meeting length: 25 minutes (quick, focused)
Objective: Clear the top two blockers, align on priorities for the next 7 days, quick career check (5m). Leave with 2 concrete action items.

Quick status (TL;DR)
- Feature branch for dynamic-batching is merged to staging; perf tests running overnight.
- Infra team needing config changes for staging GPUs (blocked on ops change request).
- User-reported regression in p99 latency for short-chat workload — intermittent, started after kernel update.
- Personal: M finishing certification course (good momentum).

What I need from them (ask)
1) Confirm repro steps for the p99 spike (logs + minimal repro) by EOD Wednesday. If they have a short curl example, great.
2) Prioritize the ops change (ticket JIRA-4521) so we can run full perf tests next week.
3) Their preferred support pattern — daily quick sync or async updates? (offer two options)

Talking points / agenda (25m)
- 0:00–02:00 quick check-in (how are you, capacity?)
- 02:00–08:00 status: dynamic-batching merge + perf smoke results (I will share summary)
- 08:00–16:00 blocking issues: p99 regression + ops change for staging GPUs
- 16:00–22:00 short career pulse: one thing they're proud of, one area they want >1:1 help on
- 22:00–25:00 decisions & action items recap

Context notes for me (private)
- The p99 regression looks correlated with the latest fused-kernel rollout (kernel v1.3.4). Ops says rollout across staging was gradual; candidate is memory alloc path for short sequences. Keep a neutral framing while probing.
- Avoid technical deep-dive unless they lead; this is quick sync. If they want a deep-dive, schedule 60m follow-up with SRE.
- They are currently mentoring two junior ICs; check bandwidth before asking for extra tasks.

Data points to share (prep)
- Latest smoke numbers: baseline p50=13ms, p95=46ms, p99=240ms (short-chat, seq len <64). Attach logs summary link.
- Perf test plan for dynamic-batching: config snippet + expected throughput lift (~1.9x)

Coaching prompts (use if time)
- "What would you try first if you were triaging the p99 spike?" (helps reveal their approach)
- "Where do you feel stuck on ownership for the staging rollout?"

Potential sensitive areas (handle gently)
- They pushed a config change last week that seemed to regress a metric—frame as learning: "What do we change next time to catch that earlier?"
- They mentioned feeling "over-scheduled" in slack last week. Offer prioritization help.

Decisions I need to make in this meeting
- Greenlight pairing with SRE for deep triage this week (if they want)
- Whether to escalate the ops change to Platform lead or let it follow normal queue (if it blocks perf tests).

Action items (explicit)
- [Assignee: Engineer] Produce minimal repro + logs snippet for p99 spike and link in ticket JIRA-4521 — due 2028-06-28. (low friction: curl example + single-run trace)
- [Assignee: Ashwin] Ping Platform lead (Sara Bloom) to request expedited ops change window; include perf test schedule — due 2028-06-28 COB.
- [Assignee: Engineer] Run one full perf smoke with new dynamic-batching config once ops change applied — target 2028-07-02.
- [Assignee: Engineer & Mentor] Quick mentor check: pair with junior IC for 30m next week to transfer triage steps — target 2028-07-01.

Follow-up plan
- If repro confirmed: schedule 60m deep-dive with SRE + infra (target 2028-06-29).
- If no repro by due date: I (Ashwin) will run through logs with them asynchronously and propose next steps.

Notes to self (style/reminder)
- Keep tone supportive; open with kudos for shipping merge.
- Don't issue directives in the 1:1; present options and offer to unblock.
- Use the word "we" when talking about escalations.

Loose questions to surface if time
- Is the current on-call rota giving you enough time for deep work?
- Any obstacles to mentoring the two juniors this sprint?

End-of-meeting script (closing)
- Quick recap of two action items and owners + confirm due dates. Ask: "Anything you need from me right now to make these happen?"

Random scratch / fragments (for my notes)
- Maybe propose "office hours" block Wed 10–11 for quick triage? trial for 2 weeks.
- Reminder: share perf test dashboards link in Slack channel #serving-runtime after they run the smoke.

Tone: lean, procedural, coaching-oriented.

---
Version history: brief scratch — created 2028-06-27; updated with smoke numbers 2028-06-30.
